items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was he more important to the clarinet than Buster Bailey or Albert Nichols?

ctx.x: As of now. I think so too. There's too many clarinet players.
Was he more important to the clarinet than Buster Bailey or Albert Nichols?
Yes because I'll tell you one reason why, because Benny was white and he got more publicity.
